summary: ```# 【Marvelous Designer】Live Stream - Bee Costume Production p05: Production of Tactical Backpack ## Introduction In this live stream session, we discuss the production of a tactical backpack using Marvelous Designer. The session outlines various techniques, materials, and considerations essential for creating a functional and visually appealing design. ## Body Shape Considerations The effect of the design is critical. Using an ordinary body shape model may yield better results, but adapting to various model shapes can be challenging. We must consider how the design fits around the body. ## Initial Thoughts on Design I remember my first live broadcast focused on the pilot jacket. Viewers often ask how to create such pieces, and while it seems straightforward, understanding the nuances is crucial. A tactical pilot jacket, for example, involves a solid foundation and soft exterior materials, which can expedite the process. ### Using 3D Drawing Tools To create the basic version of the jacket: - Use the back panel as a foundation. - Draw small lines with a 3D drawing tool to adjust the shape. - Stick with a hard fabric for the base version, adjusting its shape and size. ## Fabric and Texture When creating a white pilot model, finding the right fabric texture is essential. To incorporate wrinkles: - Use the shrink tool or positive rule to create seam-line wrinkles. - Early-stage wrinkles may seem excessive, but they often diminish after adding material. ## Belt Installation Now, it's time to install the belt. Adjust the length gradually until it fits perfectly. ### Scarf Creation I skipped the scarf part earlier, which is covered in the first lesson of our Skillshare course. It’s a simple method that doesn’t require extensive discussion. ## Basic Version and Recording The basic version utilizes a harder material with a loop. We will record this live broadcast for those who cannot attend. ### Adjusting Details Once the basic shape is complete, focus on adding details: - The "fenghuo" lines (fire lines) are often hidden inside. - Adjust these lines methodically, ensuring to check the recording for guidance. ## Fabric Properties The fabric's bending strength affects the final product. A fabric with high bending strength shows fewer wrinkles, while softer materials may accentuate them. ### Wrinkle Management Adding wrinkles intentionally can enhance the design's realism. During the process: - Consider how the fabric behaves under light. - Maintain a balance between wrinkles and smooth areas for aesthetic appeal. ## Tactical Backpack Design As we shift focus to the tactical backpack: - The design incorporates multiple models and styles. - The outer fabric should complement the structure. ### Inner and Outer Layers The inner layer should not affect the outer lines. For example: - When creating the dragon layer, ensure it harmonizes with surrounding lines. - Create pockets and design elements that enhance functionality. ## Sewing Techniques When sewing inner lines: - Use a smart top that can be torn along the inner line. - Avoid complex curves to simplify the sewing process. ### Using the Folding Arrangement Tool To create folds: - Use the folding arrangement tool to pre-fold. - This prevents issues such as twisting during sewing. ## Final Adjustments After completing various segments: - Adjust the thickness and properties of the fabric. - Explore different fabrics to achieve desired aesthetics and functionality. ### Creating Pockets Designing pockets involves various rectangles and shapes. Use free powder to sew them effectively. ## Conclusion The production of tactical gear in Marvelous Designer combines technical skill with creativity. Following this guide will enhance your understanding of fabric properties, sewing techniques, and design principles. ### Homework and Further Learning I encourage everyone to practice what we've covered in this session. Share your designs and ask questions as you progress. ```
